name: cafe-nusantara
description: Menjalankan seluruh webapp Cafe Nusantara (backend, scheduler, realtime, frontend) dengan satu perintah.

scripts.dev:lan: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "API,JADWAL,REALTIME,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green,yellow" "cd cafe-backend && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0" "npm:dev:scheduler" "cd cafe-backend && php artisan reverb:start --host=0.0.0.0" "cd cafe-frontend && npm run dev -- --host --open"
scripts.setup: cd cafe-backend && composer install && php artisan migrate --force && cd ../cafe-frontend && npm install
